text: Sorry I'm not sure if this is the right number. I'm a childminder and I've got a little girl overnight, she's 3 months old. She has chickenpox, spots all over her tummy and back and she keeps trying to rub at them, really itchy I think. I just took her temperature and it's 38.2. I'm honestly a bit scared because I've never had one this little with a temp. She's otherwise ok I think, feeding, looking at me, being her normal self. No fits or shaking or jerking or anything like that, I've been watching her closely. There's one bruise on her shin but I know exactly where that's from, she slipped off my lap on the baby slide at the playground this afternoon and bumped it on the edge. Her mum's away till tomorrow. Do I need to do anything or just keep an eye?
